headline: Paraguay Government Proposes Emergency Law for Workers Affected by Ueno Bank
summary: Paraguay Vice President Pedro Alliana announced an emergency bill to provide immediate compensation advances to workers at firms connected to intervened lender Ueno Bank. Former President Santiago Peña is seeking to annul his impeachment over the bank crisis.
why: Ueno Bank is a Paraguayan financial institution currently placed under regulatory intervention by banking authorities.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Paraguay introduced emergency legislation to compensate workers affected by Ueno Bank's failure.
